title: Prove sharp adaptive bias from a reused rounding seed (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped probability proof with exact finite corroboration. For two adjacent-grid stochastic rounding calls sharing one uniform seed modulo m, the exact worst-case absolute expected accumulated local error is

```text
beta(m) = floor(m^2/4) / m^2
```

The second integer numerator may depend on the first rounded output; the caller has no other seed-dependent information. A matching two-shear word attains beta(m) and admits exact dirty copy/uncompute. The bound is 1/4 for every nontrivial dyadic denominator, in output-grid units.

[zxv's PR6066](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6066) already supplies the restored-tape correlation warning and the m=2 counterexample. The new contribution is the all-denominator sharp optimization over every two-call adaptive policy, including both attaining signs. Its reversible-shear mechanism and Nick Petalas's PR6026 fresh-forward context retain their credit. Neither predecessor is audited or replayed here. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19361551). The delivered scope matches that question. Canonical main was refreshed at 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority revision 8.

## Evidence

Before this contribution, PR6066 supplied the qualitative warning and one two-shear example. The new conditional-probability proof gives the exact optimum for every positive integer m, signed numerators and independent private randomization.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass:

- The literal oracle exhausts all 90,000 adaptive policies through m=24 and 1,763,020 seed executions, finding both predicted extrema. It evaluates rounded outputs directly rather than using the posterior formulas.
- Separate controls cover 1,296 adaptive fresh-seed policies, 61,776 seed pairs, 204 fixed-input reuse policies, 21,420 signed translation tuples, 2,080 attaining-word seeds through m=64, 3,645 dirty copy/reverse fixtures and eight rejection controls.
- Both warning-strict normal and optimized registered checks pass. Individually timed direct commands took 0.35 and 0.36 seconds locally; these timings check the replay deadline and are not speedup claims.
- Metadata/source pins and committed-byte/source-history checks pass for all five files at 4808563c500ed0d22f939e8eb3ae44d71eba7fff.
- Both direct modes pass from a Git-free package copy, with identical generated JSON/hash receipts. No receipt is handwritten or committed.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/reused-seed-adaptive-drift/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/reused-seed-adaptive-drift/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/reused-seed-adaptive-drift
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/reused-seed-adaptive-drift --check-source-history
```

Use another CPython 3.12 path on other hosts. Expected statuses are PASS_REUSED_SEED_ADAPTIVE_DRIFT, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. Standard library only. Registered checks have 120-second limits, and every registered command ran locally.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The theorem covers exactly two calls and observation only through the first rounding result. Direct seed inspection, additional observations/calls, changed rounding laws and data-dependent stopping are excluded. This is an expected local-error bound, not a full-word concentration or native-error guarantee.

The inverse is logical integer arithmetic. Finite guard widths, reversible bit circuits, random-tape preparation/access, temporary cleanup, storage, stock, native MOVE and the complete recursive/outer bill remain unproved and unpriced. No actual P104 caller integration, supplier admission, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Global literature priority is unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Determine the exact drift for three or more calls using posterior-interval decision trees. A uniform multistep proof is missing.
- Bind one actual caller's observation and numerator dependencies to a conditional-uniformity theorem before reusing a restored seed. The physical host and complete invoice remain missing.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this two-call shared-seed adaptive optimization was found in the live lists and the cached complete-body overlap search. PR6066 is the merged predecessor that already gives the qualitative failure and the binary example. This package proves a sharp new bound rather than treating that example as original. PR6026 assumes fresh forward randomness and is unchanged. The searches cover retained public work, not unpublished contributions.
